'''Vishnu Ganesh Bhide''' (8 August 1925 – 25 June 2006) was an Indian physicist and educationist, known for his pioneering work on [[Mossbauer spectroscopy]] and his contributions to science education in India.<ref name="INSA profile">{{cite web | url=http://www.insaindia.org.in/deceaseddetail.php?id=N680096 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160812215255/http://www.insaindia.org.in/deceaseddetail.php?id=N680096 | url-status=usurped | archive-date=12 August 2016 | title=INSA profile | publisher=[[Indian National Science Academy]] | date=2015 | access-date=17 October 2015}}</ref> He was the scientific advisor to the [[Government of India]] during 1973-75 and a member of the  International Commission on the Applications of Mossbauer Effect.<ref name="INSA profile" /> The Government of India awarded him the fourth highest civilian honour of the [[Padma Shri]] in 1992.<ref name="Padma Awards">{{cite web | url=http://mha.nic.in/sites/upload_files/mha/files/LST-PDAWD-2013.pdf | title=Padma Awards | publisher=Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India | date=2015 | access-date=21 July 2015 | archive-date=19 October 2017 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171019215108/http://mha.nic.in/sites/upload_files/mha/files/LST-PDAWD-2013.pdf | url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Biography ==
Bhide, born in 1925 in [[Nagpur]], in the western Indian state of [[Maharashtra]], obtained his master's degree in Physics from [[Rashtrasant Tukadoji Maharaj Nagpur University]] with first rank and gold medal and secured a doctoral degree from the same university.<ref name="Vishnu Ganesh Bhide">{{cite web | url=http://www.iisc.ernet.in/currsci/dec102006/1574.pdf | title=Vishnu Ganesh Bhide | publisher=[[Indian Institute of Science]] | date=2015 | access-date=17 October 2015}}</ref> He started his career at the [[Institute of Science, Nagpur]], in 1956 as a member of the faculty of Physics, but, taking a break, went to the UK to study [[Solid State Physics]] and obtained a doctoral degree from the [[University of London]]. After his return, he was offered the post as the Head of the department of Physics at the erstwhile Royal Institute of Physics, Mumbai (presently known as the [[The Institute of Science, Mumbai|Institute of Science]]).<ref name="Vishnu Ganesh Bhide" /> During this period, he initiated research on [[Mossbauer spectroscopy]], a pioneering effort in India.<ref name="INSA profile" />

After serving as a scientific advisor to the Government of India from 1973 to 1975,<ref name="INSA profile" /> he moved the [[National Physical Laboratory of India|National Physical Laboratory]] as a Director-Grade scientist where he continued his research on Mossbauer effect<ref name="Mössbauer effect and its applications">{{cite book | title=Mössbauer effect and its applications | publisher=Tata McGraw-Hill | author=V. G. Bhide | year=1973 | pages=491 | oclc=1585482}}</ref> as well as on the field of alternate energy sources.<ref name="Solar drying of agricultural products">{{cite book | title=Solar drying of agricultural products | publisher=Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet | author=V. G. Bhide | year=1987 | pages=114 | isbn=9789157629586|oclc = 19574852}}</ref> In 1982, he shifted to [[Pune]] as the chairman and the [[State Bank of India]] chair professor of the ''School of Energy Studies'' and worked there till 1984 when he was appointed as the vice chancellor of [[Pune University]]. After the conclusion of his term in 1988, he worked as the founder director of the Inter-University Consortium for [[Department of Atomic Energy|DAE]] Facilities (IUC-DAEF).<ref name="INSA profile" />

Bhide documented his research by way of several books and scientific articles published in peer reviewed national and international journals.<ref name="WorldCat identitites">{{cite web | url=http://www.worldcat.org/identities/lccn-n82-253055/ | title=WorldCat identitites | publisher=WorldCat | date=2015 | access-date=17 October 2015}}</ref><ref name="Bhide, V. G. (Vishnu Ganesh), 1925-">{{cite web | url=http://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/n82253055.html | title=Bhide, V. G. (Vishnu Ganesh), 1925- | publisher=[[Library of Congress]] | date=2015 | access-date=17 October 2015}}</ref> Besides his scientific researches, he is known for his contributions to the field of science education in India. As the chairman of the ''Physic Study Group'', he was involved with the preparation of secondary school text books for the [[National Council of Educational Research and Training]] (NCERT).<ref name="INSA profile" /> He served as the Chairman of the ''Asian Working Group on Solar Energy'', as the director of the [[International Solar Energy Society]] and as a member of the ''International Commission on the Applications of Mossbauer Effect''.<ref name="INSA profile" /> He was a member of the editorial boards of journals such as [[Pramana]], ''Proceedings of [[Indian National Science Academy]]'' and ''Journal of Physics Education''.<ref name="INSA profile" /> He was the president of the [[Indian Science Congress]] in 1971 and served the [[Indian National Science Academy]] as its secretary from 1971 to 1974 and as its treasurer from 1981 to 1984.<ref name="INSA profile" />

Bhide died on 25 June 2006, survived by his wife, Prabha,<ref name="Vishnu Ganesh Bhide" /> a son, Anant Vishnu Bhide, who is an industrialist <ref name="Spectris Technologies">{{cite web | url=http://www.allcompanydata.com/in/director/anant-vishnu-bhide/1432923 | title=Spectris Technologies | publisher=All Company Data | date=2015 | access-date=17 October 2015}}</ref> and a daughter, Dr. Vidula.

== Awards and honours ==
Bhide was an elected fellow of the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]] (1974),<ref name="Past Fellows">{{cite web | url=http://www.ias.ac.in/php/pfell_all.php3?alpha=B | title=Past Fellows | publisher=[[Indian Academy of Sciences]] | date=2015 | access-date=17 October 2015}}</ref> [[National Academy of Sciences, India]],<ref name="Deceased Honorary Fellows, Foreign Fellows and Fellows">{{cite web | url=http://www.nasi.org.in/deceased.htm | title=Deceased Honorary Fellows, Foreign Fellows and Fellows | publisher=National Academy of Sciences India | date=2015 | access-date=17 October 2015 | url-status=dead | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150528102550/http://www.nasi.org.in/deceased.htm | archive-date=28 May 2015 | df=dmy-all }}</ref> [[Indian National Science Academy]], [[Maharashtra Academy of Sciences]],<ref name="Fellows List">{{cite web | url=http://mahascience.org/files/Fellowship/files/academyMembers.htm#b | title=Fellows List | publisher=Maharashtra Academy of Sciences | date=2015 | access-date=17 October 2015}}</ref> Indian Cryogenics Council and the [[Royal Astronomical Society]].<ref name="INSA profile" /> He delivered several award lectures such as INSA K. Rangadhama Rao Memorial Lecture, Parulekar Memorial Lecture, M. B. Kinkhede Memorial Lecture and Professor V. N. Thatte Memorial Lecture.<ref name="INSA profile" /> The Government of India awarded him the civilian honour of the [[Padma Shri]] in 1992.<ref name="Padma Awards" /> He was also a recipient of [[Sir C. V. Raman]] Award and [[Meghnad Saha]] Memorial Award.<ref name="INSA profile" />
